name: a-share
description: China A-share market data through AKShare's official MCP server: index and stock quotes, limit-up and broken-board pools, dragon-tiger lists, money flow, financial statements, research notes and announcements.

aktools.description: AKShare's data interface catalog over MCP: search interfaces, read their parameters, and fetch A-share, ETF, futures and China macro data
aktools.instruction: Use for A-share and China market data. Call search_interfaces first with data-type keywords (for example '涨停 池', '龙虎榜', 'A股 日线'), read describe_interface, then get_data. Parameters are text: dates as YYYYMMDD, symbols as the interface documents (600519, sh600519). Page with max_rows/offset; use save_data for a full table that code or a backtest will read. Prefer non-Eastmoney quote sources for bulk calls, and on an Eastmoney 429 switch to an alternative source instead of retrying.
